symptom: Wanting a round-trip test over Studio Pro-authored documents without committing a 15 MB project
insight: `mx create-project` (what TestMain already runs) produces Mendix's Blank template, whose FeedbackModule/Administration/Atlas documents ARE Studio Pro-authored — byte-identical to the audited PedApp units. So the integration base project is the fixture. Hold each case to several checks (exec, document, header, texts, annotations) with the ledger keyed per check: a page loses a dozen unrelated things at once, and a whole-document verdict cannot show one of them being fixed. The suite found losses the audit did not report (input-widget writer constants, DataGrid2 rebuilt from its template, activity sizes, regenerated merges)
